numerical_claims.source_value: 15,767 thousand EUR (2026) vs 15,857 thousand EUR (2025); local currency sales decrease of 7.8%
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report Russia section: 'The Group’s sales on the Russian market totalled 15 767 thousand EUR, decrease is 0.6% compared to 06 months of 2025. Local currency sales decreased by 7.8% during 06 months of 2026 compared to the same 06 months of 2025.' Sales by markets table confirms EUR amounts and change percentages.

numerical_claims.claim: Sales in Belarus increased by 6.4% to 9,046 thousand EUR, supported by a 2.7% rise in local currency sales
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 9,046 thousand EUR (2026) vs 8,500 thousand EUR (2025); local currency sales increase of 2.7%
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report Belarus section: 'The Group’s sales in Belarus in the 06 months of 2026 were 9 046 thousand EUR and increased by 6.4% compared to the 06 months of 2025. numerical_claims.claim: Sales in Ukraine plummeted by 58.3% to 15 thousand EUR

numerical_claims.source_value: 15 thousand EUR (2026) vs 36 thousand EUR (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report Ukraine section: 'The Group’s sales in Ukraine in the 06 months of 2026 were 15 thousand EUR and decreased by 58.3% compared to the 06 months of 2025.' Sales by markets table confirms EUR amounts and change percentage.

numerical_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents nearly doubled, increasing by 87.4% to 12,443 thousand EUR, while operating cash flow surged by 96.6% to 6,842 thousand EUR
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 12,443 thousand EUR (+87.4%), operating cash flow 6,842 thousand EUR (+96.6%)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 12,443 thousand EUR (2026) vs 6,639 thousand EUR (2025); operating cash flow 6,842 (2026) vs 3,481 (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 2: Cash and cash equivalents at 30.06.2026 = 12,443; 31.12.2025 = 6,639. Calculation: (12,443 - 6,639)/6,639 = ~87.4%. Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Net cash flow from operating activities for 06m 2026 = 6,842; 06m 2025 = 3,481. Calculation: (6,842 - 3,481)/3,481 = ~96.6%.

numerical_claims.claim: Total assets grew by 5.1% to 98,603 thousand EUR, and equity attributable to equity holders increased by 6.1% to 81,479 thousand EUR
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 98,603 thousand EUR (2026) vs 93,847 thousand EUR (2025); equity attributable to Parent 81,479 (2026) vs 76,768 (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Total assets 30.06.2026 = 98,603; 31.12.2025 = 93,847. Calculation: (98,603 - 93,847)/93,847 = ~5.1%. Equity attributable to equity holders of Parent 30.06.2026 = 81,479; 31.12.2025 = 76,768. Calculation: (81,479 - 76,768)/76,768 = ~6.1%.

numerical_claims.claim: Return on assets and return on equity declined to 7.8% and 9.5% respectively
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators table: ROA for 30.06.2026 = 7.8%; ROE for 30.06.2026 = 9.5%.

numerical_claims.claim: The Group ended the period with 1,594 employees and operated 135 own stores, a slight reduction from 137 at the end of 2025
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 1,594 employees (2026), 135 own stores (2026) vs 1,639 employees (2025), 137 own stores (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As of 30 June 2026, the Group employed 1 594 people (as of 31 December 2025: 1 639 people).' Own & franchise store locations table: 'At the end of the reporting period the Group... operated 525 Milavitsa and 22 Lauma Lingerie brand stores, including 135 stores operated directly by the Group (as of 31 December 2025: 137 stores).'
